title: Count leaves
statementMd:
Return the number of leaf nodes (nodes without children). The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `count_leaves([3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7])` returns `3`.
hints: A leaf has no left and no right child.
